prompt: I need help creating a comprehensive financial model for a tech startup. I have three messy data files: historical_financials.csv (3 years of revenue/expenses), funding_rounds.xlsx (investor data with some formatting issues), and market_projections.tsv (industry growth rates). Please create a professional 5-year financial projection model in Excel with proper formulas, color coding, and scenario analysis. The model should include: 1) Clean historical data with proper formatting, 2) Dynamic projections based on market growth assumptions, 3) Funding impact analysis with dilution calculations, 4) Sensitivity tables for key variables like growth rate and burn rate, 5) Executive summary dashboard. Make it investment-grade quality with zero formula errors and professional styling.
